# Chemtraceit

> Chemtraceit compares chemical synthesis routes by chemistry, cost, supply and geopolitical risk, with reagent sourcing and procurement in one invite-only platform.

Chemtraceit is a confidential, invite-only platform for chemistry teams. It plans synthesis routes from a target molecule, checks each route with atom-balance validation, prices the reagents across real suppliers, and flags supply and geopolitical risk. The tool itself requires a client account; only the pages below are public.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chemtraceit.com/): Product overview — route comparison, chemistry metrics, supplier pricing and risk checks.
- [Team](https://chemtraceit.com/team): The people behind Chemtraceit.
